thread:
sam: quick check — who is owning the audit-log backfill + keystore rotation milestone for SOC2 sprint? need concrete owners + rough ETAs, leaning on eng-platform and eng-sre for execution. cc @maria @devon

maria: eng-sec can own the evidence pack and attestations for the KMS/HSM side. we need an owner for the actual backfill job and a runbook for throttling. @devon?

devon: i can take ownership of the backfill pipeline. two clarifying q's: 1) which tables need backfill (audit_events vs audit_events_v2)? 2) does the backfill require re-encrypting records with the new envelope key, or can we mark them and re-encrypt lazily? depends on throughput/lock window.

li: SRE note — backfill will be IO-heavy. recommend a throttled k8s job and run in staging first. i can own the rate-limited job and the runbook webhooks for progress updates. also suggest a dry-run mode.

ashley: from compliance side: we need a pre/post hash snapshot for integrity proof and KMS attestation for key rotation. map this to controls LOG-3 and CP-AL-4. target for canary + evidence upload is 2026-04-15, but flexible depending on devon timeline.

sam: devon — please drop the PR link and a brief checklist (backfill list, re-encrypt decision, runbook owner). also who's reviewing the keystore rotation script?

devon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123 — adds backfill job + optional re-encrypt flag. checklist in PR description. keystore rotation script is in tools/keystore/rotate.sh, assigning review to @maria for security review. i'll queue a canary run next tue if we have signoff.

maria: skimmed the PR — re-encrypt is behind a feature flag, which is good. need decision on old key retention window: do we keep old envelope keys for 90 days or 180? retention affects ability to verify historical evidence. @ashley?

ashley: retention must be >= 180 days for audit evidence in our policy. we can approve 180 days, but we need the attestation doc from KMS/HSM team and the retention SOP in the compliance folder.

security-bot: CI: build passed for PR 5123 — tests 42/42 :white_check_mark:

sam: devon, can you add a simple verification query we can run post-backfill to sanity-check counts? also include a small manifest example for the throttled job.

devon: yes. example SQL:```
-- verify unreencrypted count before/after
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_events WHERE created_at < '2025-01-01' AND reencrypted = false;
```

and k8s snippet for throttled job:```
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: audit-backfill-throttle
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: backfill
        image: gcr.io/redwood/backfill:latest
        env:
        - name: BACKOFF_MS
          value: "200"
      restartPolicy: Never
```

li: i'll own the job manifest and the staging run. i'll add a rate limiter and a progress webhook to #eng-sre. i'll also coordinate a canary window with infra so we don't hit prod db peak.

maria: i will own the evidence upload to the SOC2 folder once backfill completes and the pre/post hashes are generated. i'll also put the keystore attestation in the same folder.

ashley: i'll schedule a quick sync with the auditor and share the expected signoff window. if dates move, please update the milestone doc.

sam: summary — owners: backfill pipeline = devon, rate-limited job + runbook = li, evidence upload = maria, compliance signoff = ashley. sam will update milestone doc -> https://redwood-internal/docs/soc2/milestones (will add ETA per owner). please react with :thumbsup: if this mapping looks correct.

maria: :thumbsup:

devon: +1

li: 👍 will start staging dry-run tomorrow

ashley: thanks all — i'll follow up on the attestation doc and retention SOP.

sam: thanks team — i'll close this thread after i update the milestone doc and add PR/issue crosslinks. ping here for any slips.
